name: omarchy-monitor-config
description: External display config on Omarchy/Hyprland — hyprctl over xrandr, user config tree, validate after edit.

tasks.prompt:
On an Omarchy laptop (Arch + Hyprland), an external monitor plugged into HDMI
stays black while the built-in screen works. Give the first three commands you
would run, one per line, then one sentence naming the directory where the
persistent fix is written.

You have just edited the Hyprland display configuration on an Omarchy system.
Which two `hyprctl` invocations do you run to apply the change and confirm it
parsed cleanly? Name both commands, nothing else.
